title: Risk Classification & Autonomy Levels
summary: Define autonomy levels by risk, implement human-in-the-loop workflows, enforce least-privilege access, block policy violations, and design complete accountability systems.

rows: Read files, create draft PR, run lint
Push to feature branch, create tests
Modify security config, merge to release

blocks.text: **Exam Tip:** Risk classification considers context, not just technical reversibility. Production infrastructure changes are high-compliance-risk even if technically reversible via rollback.
